content: 01 / ABOUT ME, My date of birth is July-1995. More than just writing code. I started my career in 2016. Today I design, build and lead production systems. I'm Mehul Joshi, a Senior Full Stack Engineer and Technical Lead with 10 years of experience building SaaS products, enterprise applications and mobile platforms. My engineering journey has evolved from backend development to full-stack engineering, system architecture, performance optimization, cloud infrastructure and technical leadership. I enjoy solving difficult engineering problems — especially when scalability, performance, maintainability and reliability matter.

02 / TOOLBOX, Engineering capabilities. A decade of experience across frontend, backend, mobile, databases, cloud infrastructure, architecture and AI-assisted development. 1. Frontend Engineering: Building responsive, scalable and maintainable interfaces for complex business applications. React, Next.js, Angular, Redux, TypeScript. 2. Backend Engineering: Designing reliable APIs, services and backend architectures capable of handling demanding workloads. Node.js, Express, REST, Laravel, Microservices. 3. Data & Databases: Database design, query optimization, indexing, caching and high-performance data access. MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL. 4. Cloud & DevOps: Building deployment workflows and production infrastructure with modern cloud tooling. AWS, EC2, ECS, S3, Docker, CI/CD. 5. Mobile Engineering: Developing cross-platform mobile applications and integrating them with scalable backend services. React Native, REST APIs. 6. AI-Assisted Engineering: Using modern AI tools to accelerate development, automation, debugging and engineering productivity. Copilot, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini, Cursor

03 / THE JOURNEY, 10 years. One evolving story. Every stage of my career changed the way I think about software. 2016, The Beginning, Started my professional software engineering journey as a PHP Developer. Built web applications, worked with MySQL and learned the fundamentals of real-world software development. 2018, Becoming Full Stack, Expanded into Laravel, React, Angular, WordPress, REST APIs, payment gateways and third-party integrations while building commercial products. 2020, Product Engineering, Started thinking beyond individual features. Focus shifted toward architecture, maintainability, performance and complete product ownership. 2022 Enterprise Engineering Joined RyDOT Infotech as a Senior Software Engineer. Built web and mobile platforms using React, Angular, React Native, Node.js and Express. 2023-2025, Scale & Architecture, Worked on enterprise systems handling 200K+ daily requests and 15K+ active users. Focused heavily on database optimization, caching, API performance and microservices. 2023-2025, Leadership, Progressed into Senior Engineer and Team Lead responsibilities, mentoring developers, reviewing architecture and helping teams deliver production software. 2026, Engineering + AI, Currently focused on scalable architecture, engineering leadership, automation and AI-powered development workflows — including building an AI-powered Jira automation agent.

04 / EXPERIENCE, Where I've built things. NOV 2025 — JUL 2026 ULORA TECHNOLOGIES, Senior Software Engineer / Team Lead, Led a team of 3 engineers, coordinated project execution, performed code reviews, managed Agile workflows and designed CI/CD pipelines. Also developed an AI-powered Jira automation agent to reduce repetitive project-management work. Leadership Node.js Express.js React.js AI Automation CI/CD Jenkins Jira. MAR 2022 — OCT 2025 RYDOT INFOTECH, Senior Software Engineer / Team Lead, Designed and developed scalable web and mobile applications. Worked across React, Angular, React Native, Node.js and Express while owning complete software development lifecycles. Led engineering initiatives around performance, microservices, production reliability and developer mentoring. Leadership React.js Angular Next.js React Native Node.js Express.js Microservices Architecture Monolithic Architecture AWS Jira AI Tools. JAN 2018 — MAR 2022 REPUTE INFOSYSTEMS, Full Stack Developer, Built commercial WordPress products and full-stack applications using Laravel, React, Angular and MySQL. Worked on Sociamonials, ARForms, ARMember and ARPrice, including payment integrations, authentication, membership systems and social-media automation. WordPress PHP Laravel React Angular MySQL. JUN 2016 — OCT 2017 BINARYBITS, PHP Developer, Began my professional software engineering career. Developed PHP applications, automated data extraction tools and MySQL-based systems. PHP JavaScript MySQL Web Development

05 / SELECTED WORK, Problems I've helped solve. A selection of enterprise and commercial systems I've worked on throughout my career. PROJECT / 01 Courier ERP, Enterprise logistics platform supporting courier booking, tracking, delivery operations, reporting and real-time data synchronization. Impact: 200K+ requests/day Angular Node.js Express.js Electron mongoDB PostgreSQL FCM Redis Microservices. PROJECT / 02 Radiant, Real-time solar monitoring platform for collecting, processing and visualizing energy-generation data through dashboards and APIs. Focus: Real-time monitoring React Node.js Express.js MQTT REST APIs mongoDB. PROJECT / 03 Digital Walls, Digital signage platform for managing dynamic content distribution, scheduling, campaigns, screen updates and analytics. Focus: Scalable content delivery React Node.js Express.js REST APIs mongoDB. PROJECT / 04 Sociamonials, Social-media management platform supporting content scheduling, campaign management, analytics, media management and automated publishing workflows. Focus: Automation & integrations Laravel React MySQL REST APIs. PROJECT / 05 AI Jira Automation Agent, AI-powered engineering automation designed to reduce repetitive Jira project-management tasks and improve team productivity. Focus: AI + Developer Productivity AI Jira Automation Node.js REST APIs
06 / HOW I THINK, From feature to system. My approach has evolved from writing individual features to thinking about complete systems.

07 / AI ENGINEERING, I don't use AI to replace engineering. I use AI to amplify it. AI-assisted development has become part of my engineering workflow — from architecture exploration and code generation to debugging, testing, documentation and automation. → GitHub Copilot — development acceleration → ChatGPT / Codex — reasoning, engineering assistance and development → Gemini Code Assist — code analysis and development → Cursor AI — AI-native development workflow
